fields.Name: T168 - Test Run Detail Panel
fields.Description: Opens the Runs detail slide-in panel with the expanded evaluation-badge, score-indicator, and execution-context widgets — a distinct read/inspect surface separate from the generic record preview panel.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Runs" tab. If any test run rows are present, click a run row (or its eye/View-details icon) and verify a slide-in detail panel opens on the right showing the test name, a metrics grid (Score, Duration, Cost, Started), an expanded Evaluation section, and a Human Feedback area. Close it with the X or the Escape key. Seeing the detail panel render for a run is success; if there are genuinely no runs, confirming the "No test runs found" empty state renders is also acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a run row opens a slide-in detail panel (or a valid empty state confirms there are no runs to open)
The detail panel shows the test name plus a metrics grid (Score/Duration/Cost/Started) and an Evaluation section
The panel can be dismissed (close button or Escape)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
